published_prior_art.cite: NabiGuoLiu2026 leaves multi-constraint completeness open; its sequential two-Verma calculation is only the stated sanity case.
Newey1990 supplies the canonical-gradient and convolution framework; the exact loss identity is a Hilbert-space corollary conditional on Theorem 1.

HristachePatilea2016 treats ordinary conditional moments and BadeaGrivauxMuller2012 known deterministic subspaces; neither gives learned post-fixing-projector inference under a new tangent characterization.
BadeaGrivauxMuller2012 gives deterministic cyclic-projection geometry, not honest adaptive semiparametric intervals with learned fixing projectors.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / flagship comparison
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed strict extension is framed only against NabiGuoLiu2026, while PhungShpitser2026 and Evans2018 are expressly merely informed-by; this single-comparator axis-(c) claim is capped at field below the flagship target.

soundness_flags.label: Target estimand and D0_P
soundness_flags.one_line: For an arbitrary hidden-variable ADMG, E_P[Y^nu] is not an observed-law functional and the displayed g-formula influence function is not causal without an identifying graphical condition or an explicit observed-law redefinition.

soundness_flags.label: def:fixed-interaction-map and thm:joint-fixing-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: C_j permits variables outside X_j,Y_j,Z_j, but F_P double-centers the log of the full fixed kernel rather than the relevant X_j,Y_j,Z_j marginal or conditional kernel, so its zero set need not encode C_j.

soundness_flags.label: R_P
soundness_flags.one_line: R_P is defined using (A_{B,P}A_{B,P}^*)^{-1} before surjectivity or positive kappa_P is established, so it is not defined on the stated ambient class.

soundness_flags.label: ass:uniform-density-positivity
soundness_flags.one_line: NabiGuoLiu2026's fixing regularity requires positivity of the relevant fixing denominator on reference support, not the globally uniform c_P <= p <= C_P condition tagged as standard from that paper.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nuisance-product
soundness_flags.one_line: ChernozhukovEtAl2018 supports ordinary orthogonal-score remainder conditions, but not the added kappa_n^{-1} amplification; retag this target-specific strengthening as novel and justify or derive its attainability.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:joint-fixing-completeness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Completeness is asserted only for laminar fixing-forest ADMGs in the uniformly positive Sobolev chart, not for arbitrary ADMGs or merely L2-dominated laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The curve-lifting and tangent-space equality claim is conditional on the stated LFF graph property and chart regularity.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4, Proposition 3 and the following conjectured-completeness remark; Appendix S4.2, equations (S46)-(S51) and the solution following (S51); Section 3.1, reference-density remark after equation (9)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 3 gives only a residual-span inclusion under multiple constraints and the paper states general reverse inclusion remains open; Appendix S4.2 supplies the valid second-order sequential witness. Its fixing regularity states positivity of p(R | mb_G(R)) on reference support plus integrability, not globally uniform lower and upper bounds for p.
The paper defines nested models through fixing, ordered local/global properties, and factorization for ADMGs, supporting its use as graphical substrate.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2607.23439v1, 26 July 2026; UAI proceedings pagination not inspected
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The result concerns Markov models defined by ordinary marginal and conditional-independence restrictions, rather than fixing-derived Verma interactions.
The paper characterizes conditional-moment efficiency bounds through decreasing unconditional-moment models and gives an iterative backfitting approximation to the efficient score.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1006.2047; corroborating preprint, with exact journal theorem numbering requiring source verification
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies convergence of products of fixed known projections and the quick-uniform versus arbitrarily-slow dichotomy; it does not address estimated projectors.

The DML conditions give generic nuisance-quality requirements; in smooth problems the usual displayed translation is an L2 error epsilon_N with second-order remainder of order epsilon_N^2 and no reduced-minimum-modulus factor.
The paper develops semiparametric efficiency bounds, their calculation, efficient-estimator construction, and limiting distributions.
The paper gives identification and influence-function estimators for causal effects in hidden-variable graphical models, conditional on graphical identification criteria.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a declared causal-identification condition for the stochastic intervention, or replace the target by the explicitly observed stochastic-shift functional; then derive the corresponding nonparametric influence function for the allowed ADMG class.

Redefine every fixing interaction using the correct marginal or conditional post-fixing kernel and require the relevant blocks to partition the kernel variables or explicitly carry all remaining variables in the conditioning block.
Move the right inverse behind a proved split-surjectivity conclusion, or define a Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse and state the right-inverse identity only when kappa_P is positive.

Add a second theorem-level comparator, preferably a precise infinite-state extension comparison to Evans2018 in addition to NabiGuoLiu2026, with an explicit inclusion between its published class and G_LFF.
Retag the kappa_n-amplified nuisance-product requirement as novel and supply a learner/Gram-conditioning theorem that yields it under observable primitive conditions.

recommended_next_step: Revise the target and fixing-map definitions first, then establish an independently anchored two-comparator extension claim before returning this field-tier kernel to the flagship review track.
